justification: Inspected `javaparser-symbol-solver-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/symbolsolver/SourceFileInfoExtractor.java` and `javaparser-symbol-solver-testing/src/test/java/com/github/javaparser/symbolsolver/resolution/AnalyseJavaSymbolSolver060Test.java`. The class is 228 lines with 17 methods total (10 public, 7 private) and 7 mutable fields; it combines parser configuration in the constructor, file-system walking in `solve(Path)`/`solveMethodCalls(Path)`, AST traversal in `collectAllNodes` and recursive `solve`/`solveMethodCalls(Node)`, symbol resolution/formatting in `solveTypeDecl` and `toString(...)`, plus output/counter bookkeeping via `PrintStream` fields and success/failure counters. This is a mixed-responsibility utility that could be decomposed into smaller, more cohesive classes, so insufficient modularization is present.
